step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensor
step1_figure.description: Figure 17.36 shows the NMOS-input delta-sigma modulator (DSM) column sensing circuit using PMOS cup capacitors and NMOS bucket capacitors, with a dynamic PMOS-input comparator clocked by phi2 and an SR latch producing Q and Qi feedback signals.

shifted_reference_voltage.description: Shifted reference voltage level applied to the integrator branch after NMOS threshold drop

equation.explanation: The reference voltage VR applied to the NMOS source follower experiences a threshold voltage drop VTHN, shifting the active integration range.
equation.assumptions: NMOS source follower operates in saturation with negligible body effect modulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_R = 0.65 V. For SKY130 NMOS, VTHN = 0.42 V. V_R,shift = 0.65 - 0.42 = 0.23 V = 230 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With VTHN nominally 0.42 V across process corners (0.37 V to 0.47 V), VR,shift sits between 180 mV and 280 mV.

shifted_signal_voltage.description: Shifted pixel intensity voltage level applied to the signal branch after NMOS threshold drop

equation.explanation: The light signal voltage VI experiences the same NMOS source-follower threshold drop VTHN before driving the integrator.
equation.assumptions: Matched threshold voltage between reference and signal NMOS source followers.

sky130_expected.calculation: For VI = 0.64 V and VTHN = 0.42 V, V_I,shift = 0.64 - 0.42 = 0.22 V = 220 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly tracks VI with the nominal 0.42 V NMOS threshold drop.

sensing_resolution.description: Voltage sensing resolution of the DSM converter over N clock cycles

equation.explanation: The resolution is the minimum detectable change in voltage, defined by dividing the full-scale shifted reference range by the number of clock integration cycles N.
equation.assumptions: Linear integration over N cycles without comparator hysteresis loss.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by shifted reference range (230 mV) divided by N = 100.

sensed_signal_voltage.description: Digital estimate of the shifted intensity voltage reconstructed from modulator output count M

equation.explanation: The average charge balance in the bucket capacitor forces the reference branch to feed back charge for M out of N cycles matching the continuous signal charge.
equation.assumptions: Equilibrium reached across N clock periods, delta-sigma feedback loop is stable.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Should reconstruct the input VI,shift within one LSB resolution step (2.3 mV).

switched_cap_reference_resistance.description: Equivalent resistance of the switched-capacitor reference branch

equation.explanation: Effective resistance synthesized by transferring charge C_cup * delta_V at clock frequency f.
equation.assumptions: Non-overlapping clocks allow full charge and discharge of cup capacitor C_cup.

sky130_expected.calculation: For C_cup = 50 fF (PMOS 50/10 capacitor) and f_clk = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns): R_R = 1 / (100e6 * 50e-15) = 200 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard switched-capacitor equivalent resistance with 50 fF cup capacitance at 100 MHz clock rate.

switched_cap_signal_resistance.description: Effective average resistance of the switched-capacitor signal branch enabled during M_bar cycles

equation.explanation: Average resistance scaled inversely with the duty cycle / fractional activation M_bar/N of the branch.
equation.assumptions: Uniform distribution of switching pulses over measurement window N.

sky130_expected.calculation: With R_R = 200 kOhm and duty fraction M_bar/N = 0.96: R_I = 200 kOhm / 0.96 = 208.3 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Slightly higher than reference resistance proportional to ratio N/M.

sensing_measurement_time.description: Total measurement duration for N clock cycles

equation.explanation: Total sense conversion time equal to number of samples N multiplied by the master clock period T_clk.

sky130_expected.calculation: N = 100 cycles, T_clk = 10 ns (f_clk = 100 MHz): T_meas = 100 * 10 ns = 1.0 us = 1000 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Set by 100 clock cycles of 10 ns period.

hold_capacitor_thermal_noise.description: RMS thermal noise voltage sampled onto the hold capacitor C_H

equation.explanation: Equipartition kT/C sampled thermal noise across hold capacitor C_H.
equation.assumptions: T = 300 K, Boltzmann constant k = 1.38e-23 J/K.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct kT/C calculation for 1 pF capacitor at room temperature.

v2i_converter_current.description: Current generated by linear voltage-to-current converter from column voltage

equation.explanation: PMOS source follower with source resistor R translates column voltage V_col into current.
equation.assumptions: PMOS device operated in saturation with wide W so VSG approx |VTHP|.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ohm's law across source degeneration resistor minus gate-source drop.

v2i_input_compliance_limit.description: Maximum allowable column voltage for linear voltage-to-current conversion

equation.explanation: Upper input voltage limit ensuring the PMOS current source has sufficient overdrive to remain active.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by supply minus PMOS threshold.

step3_testbench.description: Transient and DC testbench for the DSM imager sensing circuit (Fig. 17.36) in SKY130 verifying shifted voltages, non-overlapping clocks, comparator latching, and delta-sigma modulation output
